mustangTime.title: Mustang Time
mustangTime.body:
Mustang Time runs every Wednesday from 8:15-9:00 AM. Use this block for tutoring, make-up work, and small-group support. Attendance must be taken in Skyward each week.

Roster changes should be submitted to the front office by the end of the day Friday for the following week.

hrs.title: HRS (Homeroom / Advisory)
hrs.body:
HRS meets daily from 8:00-8:15 AM. This is a good time to check in with students, cover announcements, and monitor grades together.

Weekly HRS talking points will be posted here and in the Weekly Updates section.

studentSupport.title: Student Support
studentSupport.body:
For academic concerns, start with the counseling office. For behavior or safety concerns, use the referral form under Forms & Documents or contact administration directly.

School counselor: Available by appointment, Monday-Friday.
School social worker: On campus Tuesdays and Thursdays.

attendanceDiscipline.title: Attendance & Discipline
attendanceDiscipline.body:
Take attendance every period in Skyward, no later than 10 minutes into class. Repeated unexcused absences should be flagged to the attendance office.

For minor classroom behavior issues, handle at the classroom level first. For anything involving safety, drugs/alcohol, or repeated defiance, submit a referral immediately.

procedures.title: School Procedures
procedures.body:
Fire drill: Exit using the posted route in each room, take your class roster with you, report to your assigned outdoor location.

Lockdown: Lock the door, turn off lights, move students away from windows, remain silent until an all-clear is given by administration.

Emergency substitute plans should be kept updated in your top desk drawer or shared folder.
